docContent.p10:
Purpose

This proof-of-concept board models how Telos NZ Limited, operating as Telos Ready, may turn business problems into trusted purpose-built AI software and durable customer value.

Scope

The board covers market fit, Blueprint discovery, product and agent delivery, trust and verification, customer adoption, managed service, and scalable growth through App Directors. It is a bounded strategic model, not an exhaustive operating manual.

Key assumptions

  • The user intended Telos Ready, the Wellington full-stack AI software company, rather than Telos Group Real Estate.
  • Public website descriptions are directional marketing and service information, not independently verified operating performance.
  • Actual customer economics, delivery capacity, control effectiveness, and internal accountabilities require Telos review.

Sources and cautions

Primary public sources used include the Telos homepage, About, Pricing, Skills Directory, Terms, Privacy, and the accounting-firm offering. Causal links are hypotheses for discussion and need human and subject-matter review.
docContent.p11:
Illustrative monitoring and evaluation plan

Use a small balanced set of commercial, delivery, assurance, adoption, and durability signals. Agree definitions, owners, baselines, targets, review cadence, and decision rules before operational use.

Illustrative measures

Illustrative evaluation questions

Suggested learning rhythm

  • Review delivery and assurance signals with each release.
  • Review adoption and support signals monthly with customer teams.
  • Review customer value, retention, and App Director capacity quarterly.
  • Record changes made because of evidence, not only performance results.

measures.title: Qualified organisations entering Blueprint discovery
measures.mainText: Count organisations that meet the agreed ideal-customer and use-case criteria.

measures.title: Blueprint-to-first-live-workflow elapsed time
measures.mainText: Track elapsed calendar time from accepted Blueprint scope to the first production workflow.

measures.title: Priority workflows passing acceptance first time
measures.mainText: Monitor the proportion of priority workflows accepted without material rework.

measures.title: High-risk outputs caught before release
measures.mainText: Track verification findings resolved before customer-facing release.

measures.title: Active use of priority workflows
measures.mainText: Measure sustained use by intended staff rather than logins alone.

measures.title: Customer retention and expansion
measures.mainText: Track renewals, plan continuity, and approved expansion work separately.

evalQuestions.questionText: Which customer problems create enough value for a purpose-built system?
evalQuestions.mainText: Compare problem severity, process centrality, willingness to change, and ownership appetite.

evalQuestions.questionText: Does the Blueprint capture critical exceptions as well as normal workflows?
evalQuestions.mainText: Test the model with staff stories, artefacts, and deliberately difficult edge cases.

evalQuestions.questionText: Which agentic workflows remain too risky or ambiguous to automate?
evalQuestions.mainText: Review autonomy boundaries, reversibility, verification needs, and consequences of error.

evalQuestions.questionText: Do verification controls build trust without blocking useful delivery?
evalQuestions.mainText: Examine defects caught, false alarms, review effort, and user confidence together.

evalQuestions.questionText: Which adoption conditions best predict realised customer value?
evalQuestions.mainText: Compare sponsorship, champion capability, workflow fit, support use, and retired workarounds.

evalQuestions.questionText: Can the App Director model scale without weakening fit or accountability?
evalQuestions.mainText: Review portfolio load, local judgement, platform support, quality variation, and customer outcomes.
